color_method: For every display triangle, color is the arithmetic mean of its three actual native nodal displacement magnitudes mapped to the displayed mm color legend. It is not generated from the single retained probe.
confirmation_scope: Only exact same-mesh/load elastic numerical replay and visualization. No cracking, prestress, segment-joint, contact, fatigue, manufacturing or operating approval.
final_image_description: Actual complete native FieldCraft U field, 100x deformed geometry, mm legend, actual near-centre deck nodal samples
geometry_method: Every tetra10 exterior face uses all three actual corner nodes and all three actual midside nodes, subdivided into four planar display triangles. Vertex positions are actual native XYZ + 100*actual native U. No exact curved-patch claim.
isolation: Native execution: successful Linux bubblewrap (read-only host/input, hidden HOME, network unshared), per-process POSIX address/CPU/file limits. Coordinator itself unrestricted; hash checks before/after.
preserved_failure: Original postprocessor rejected bitwise coordinate equality; 10-decimal ASCII rounding is now separately bounded <=5.1e-11 m while saved mesh.bin stays byte-identical. No additional solve.
public_recommendation: Publish final02 PNG, figure receipt, handoff-v2, surface check and compact v2 native field (3.12 MB). Full VTU and mesh may be losslessly gzipped for exact offline validation. Keep the results-embedded native project as downloadable release evidence.
